# IPCC Data Distribution Centre

> The authoritative archive for Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change assessment reports, climate datasets, and FAIR-compliant climate data access.

IPCC Data provides a comprehensive platform for accessing climate data from multiple assessment reports (AR4, AR5, AR6) and distributing curated climate scenarios and environmental datasets to researchers and policymakers worldwide. The site is operated by the IPCC Data Distribution Centre (DDC) in partnership with leading climate data institutions including DKRZ and CIESIN.

## Key Topics

- IPCC (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change)
- AR6 (Sixth Assessment Report)
- Data Distribution Centre (DDC)
- Climate data archive
- FAIR guidelines
- Climate scenarios
- Assessment reports
- Climate datasets
- Environmental data
- Data catalogue
- DKRZ
- CIESIN
- WGI (Working Group I)
- WGIII (Working Group III)
- MetadataWorks

## Core Access & Navigation

- [IPCC Data Homepage](https://ipcc-data.org/index.html): IPCC Data Distribution Centre homepage with climate data archive and assessment reports
- [AR6 Data Hub](https://ipcc-data.org/ar6landing.html): AR6 assessment data hub with FAIR guidelines and interactive climate datasets
